probes.summary: Read-only live and saved gateway, routing, NAT, service, and client-path checks completed.
limitations: Reboot persistence was not directly exercised by this read-only probe.

probes.summary: Read-only operational audit completed across all four nodes.
limitations: configctl firewall list rules returned “Action not allowed or missing”; equivalent pfctl and generated-rule checks were available.

assertions.summary: All declared zone addresses and primary data-plane routes are present on the intended interfaces; management routes have lower priority.

evidence.observation: vtnet1 owns 10.80.3.1/24, vtnet2 owns 10.80.1.1/24, and vtnet3 owns 10.80.2.1/24. Connected routes use vtnet1, vtnet2, and vtnet3 respectively.

evidence.command: ip -4 -o addr show; ip -4 route show
evidence.observation: node2 owns 10.80.2.10/24 on enp8s0 and uses default via 10.80.2.1 dev enp8s0 metric 100.

evidence.command: ip -4 -o addr show; ip -4 route show; ip -4 route get 10.80.2.10
evidence.observation: node3 owns 10.80.1.10/24 on enp8s0 and routes 10.80.2.10 via 10.80.1.1 dev enp8s0 from source 10.80.1.10.

evidence.command: ip -4 -o addr show; ip -4 route show; ip -4 route get 10.80.3.1
evidence.observation: node4 owns 10.80.3.10/24 on enp8s0 and reaches 10.80.3.1 directly via enp8s0 from source 10.80.3.10.

limitations: Reboot persistence was not directly exercised.

assertions.summary: The LAN direct path returns the required marker, and the WAN path returns it through the declared 8443-to-8080 translation.

evidence.observation: Python listens on 0.0.0.0:8080 and the local root response is exactly infraset-dmz.
The intended LAN-sourced route is via 10.80.1.1 and the direct response is infraset-dmz.
The intended WAN-sourced request reaches 10.80.3.1 directly and returns infraset-dmz.

evidence.command: sudo -n pfctl -ss | grep -E '10\.80\.(1\.10|2\.10|3\.10)|8443|8080' || true; sudo -n pfctl -sn | grep -E 'rdr|8443|8080' || true
evidence.observation: Active states show direct 10.80.1.10 to 10.80.2.10:8080 and translated 10.80.3.10 to 10.80.2.10:8080 via 10.80.3.1:8443. Active NAT has one rdr pass rule: vtnet1:8443 to 10.80.2.10:8080.

assertions.summary: Three root-owned task-specific config backups remain outside OPNsense's normal /conf/backup history, so stale residue remains.

evidence.command: sudo -n sh -c 'for p in /conf/config.xml.bak-associated-pass /conf/config.xml.bak-no-wan-direct /conf/config.xml.bak-three-zone; do [ -e "$p" ] && stat -f "%Su:%Sg|%N|%z|%Sm" "$p"; done'
evidence.observation: The following root:wheel files remain: /conf/config.xml.bak-associated-pass, /conf/config.xml.bak-no-wan-direct, and /conf/config.xml.bak-three-zone. They are task-specific backups outside /conf/backup.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true; systemctl is-enabled ssh sshd 2>&1 || true; ip -4 route show; ss -ltnup 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: No failed units; SSH units report disabled/not-found; one intended default route and one intended HTTP listener on 8080 are present.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true; systemctl is-enabled ssh sshd 2>&1 || true; ip -4 route show; ss -ltnup 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: No failed units; SSH units report disabled/not-found; routes are not duplicated beyond the intended primary and management paths, with no extra application listener.

evidence.command: systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain || true; systemctl is-enabled ssh sshd 2>&1 || true; ip -4 route show; ss -ltnup 2>/dev/null
evidence.observation: No failed units; SSH units report disabled/not-found; routes are not duplicated beyond the intended primary and management paths, with no extra application listener.

failures: Stale task-specific OPNsense configuration backups remain outside the normal backup-history directory.
limitations: configctl firewall list rules returned “Action not allowed or missing”; this did not prevent the independent stale-backup failure decision.

actions_performed: Executed read-only managed checks on node1, node2, node3, and node4.
Closed live evidence exactly once after all probes completed.
overall_summary: The three-zone addressing and application contract passes. The operational-state assertion fails because three stale task-specific OPNsense config backups remain outside normal history.
